about.cta: Join the Fujisat Pay revolution. Contact our team today to learn more.

storyMission.content: Fujisat Pay is the result of the expertise and vision of Graphics System SA, a Cameroonian technology company with a mission to revolutionize mobile payment management in Africa. With our deep knowledge of the local market and business challenges, we have developed a robust, secure platform that complies with international standards.
storyMission.title: Our Story & Mission

about.title: About Fujisat Pay: Your Strategic Partner in Mobile Payment Solutions in Cameroon

vision.content: To become the undisputed leader in mobile payment aggregation in Africa, actively contributing to financial inclusion and digital transformation of businesses.
vision.title: Our Vision

values.compliance: We adhere to the highest regulatory standards and compliance requirements, ensuring all transactions meet CEMAC regulations and international financial security protocols.
values.excellence: We are committed to delivering exceptional service quality, innovative solutions, and continuous improvement in everything we do for our clients.
values.security: We prioritize the protection of your financial data and transactions with enterprise-grade encryption, multi-level authentication, and comprehensive audit trails.
values.support: We provide dedicated technical support and customer service to ensure your success, with expert assistance available whenever you need it.
values.transparency: We believe in clear communication, honest pricing, and complete visibility into all transactions and operations on our platform.

Centralized system configuration management
Multi-currency and country support
Flexible fee structure configuration
Payment method customization
administration.description: Streamline your operations with powerful administrative tools. Manage settings, configure fees, set up payment methods, and control system parameters from a single unified interface.
administration.details: Our administration features provide comprehensive control over your entire payment ecosystem, allowing you to adapt the system to your specific business requirements.
administration.title: System Administration

Real-time balance tracking
Multi-currency wallet support
Automated balance reconciliation
Balance alerts and notifications
balanceManagement.description: Maintain accurate real-time balances across all accounts, wallets, and mobile money operators. Track funds movement and ensure financial accuracy at all times.
balanceManagement.details: Our balance management system provides real-time visibility into all financial positions, automated reconciliation with mobile money operators, multi-currency support, and configurable alerts to prevent overdrafts and maintain operational liquidity.
balanceManagement.title: Balance Management

features.intro: Fujisat Pay is designed to offer total control over your mobile financial operations in Cameroon, thanks to a suite of advanced and secure features.

kyc.benefits:
Digital document collection and verification
Multi-level approval workflow
Secure document storage with encryption
Compliance with regulatory requirements
kyc.description: Ensure compliance and build trust with robust KYC (Know Your Customer) verification processes. Streamline customer onboarding while meeting regulatory requirements.
kyc.details: Our KYC system helps you verify customer identities efficiently while maintaining the highest security standards and regulatory compliance.
kyc.title: KYC Management

moneyTransfers.benefits:
Peer-to-peer transfer capabilities
Cross-wallet and cross-operator transfers
Instant transfer processing
Transaction limit controls
moneyTransfers.description: Enable seamless money transfers between users, wallets, and mobile money operators. Support both internal and external transfer operations with real-time processing.
moneyTransfers.details: Our money transfer module facilitates instant fund movement across different mobile money operators and internal wallets, with configurable limits, fee structures, and comprehensive transaction tracking for complete visibility.
moneyTransfers.title: Money Transfers

multiEnterprise.title: Multi-Enterprise Management

notifications.details: Our notification engine ensures timely delivery of critical information through SMS, email, and in-app channels, with customizable templates for different event types.
notifications.title: Smart Notifications

Driver payout management

delivery.problem: Managing cash collection from customers, processing driver payouts, reconciling transactions across multiple delivery agents and operators.
delivery.solution: Automate cash-on-delivery payments, manage driver earnings, and reconcile all transactions in real-time across Orange Money and MTN Mobile Money.

ecommerce.benefits:
Seamless checkout experience
Automated payment reconciliation
Multi-operator integration
Real-time transaction tracking
ecommerce.problem: Strong dependence on mobile payment, tedious reconciliation of transactions by operator, need for a smooth customer experience.
ecommerce.solution: Provide a unified payment gateway for Orange Money and MTN Mobile Money with automated reconciliation, real-time notifications, and seamless customer checkout experience.

fintech.title: Financial Services & FinTech
